title: Onboarding step on desktop-account replies
description: Additive (HolobotsMobile onboarding-host-1, DECISIONS #72.3-#72.5) top-level `onboarding` on every desktop-account-1/2/3 reply of desktopAccountSnapshot; no wire version change. Host-owned (users/{uid}.onboarding {step, skipped, stepAt}, server-only); Unity reads it and presents (hard rule 1). NOT inside storyFlags. step is the brief's beat index 0-7 and stepId its stable lowercase id (arrive, companion, first_walk, mentor_duel, market, repair, goal, done). A profile with no stored field (every account created before this lane) reads as returning: {step: 7, stepId: done, skipped: true, stepAt: null}. createGenesisProfile starts new accounts at {step: 0, skipped: false}. skipped implies step 7. stepAt is the host epoch ms of the last step change (null only for the returning default). Clients move it with desktopAccountSnapshot {operation: 'ackOnboarding', onboarding: {advance: n} | {skip: true}} (monotonic, idempotent); steps 3, 4, 5 also advance on host events (first rival settle, first vendor purchase, first workshop heal or healing-item use).
